decisions.story_title: CISA adds three Linux kernel vulnerabilities to KEV catalog with confirmed active exploitation
decisions.reason: German report on CISA adding CVE-2026-53266, CVE-2025-39964, CVE-2025-39682 to KEV. Red Hat confirmed exploitation Sep 19. Distinct from the four PoC-based privilege escalation flaws (different CVEs, different context).

CVE-2026-53266.evidence: CISA KEV entry added Sep 19 with confirmed active exploitation. Red Hat advisory updated Sep 19 02:00 UTC.

CVE-2025-39964.evidence: CISA KEV entry added Sep 19 with confirmed active exploitation in af_alg socket.

CVE-2025-39682.evidence: CISA KEV entry added Sep 19 with confirmed active exploitation in TLS rx_list handling.
